list.title: Style library
list.description: Every base style: how many of its variants show on the storefront, what holds the rest back, and who signs off what.

detail.title: Style
detail.readinessTitle: What it takes to show on the storefront
detail.readinessIntro: Each check has its sign-off for those who may give it; showing is recomputed at once.

check.namesMarketing: Thai / English names — Marketing approves the wording
check.namesPrepress: Thai / English names — Prepress approves the technical terms
check.recipeWaiting: v{version} awaits Prepress (never whoever imported it)
check.noRecipe: No recipe yet — import a recipe bundle
check.productType: Product type it is priced as

detail.verifyReferenceIntro: Type {code} as it appears in the FEFCO / ECMA edition the company holds; it is checked against the library's code.
detail.reasonsTitle: Why some variants are not shown
detail.reasonsIntro: Variants held back by each reason, and what clears it

curation.readOnly: You can see this; editing needs the style curation permission
curation.namesIntro: What customers read on the style page
curation.descriptionHint: Shown on the style and feature pages; empty uses the master file's construction
curation.namesReset: Changing a name clears both name approvals: the style leaves the storefront until they are given again
curation.showingIntro: Featured, hidden, order, and the product type it is priced as
curation.featuredHint: First in the library and on the home page
curation.hiddenHint: Hides every variant without deleting anything
curation.productTypeHint: Prices it and opens its quotation form
curation.useCasesIntro: The style appears on the "boxes for …" page of each product chosen
curation.useCasesImport: The next master file import replaces these with the file's, when the file lists them
curation.synonymsIntro: Words customers type that should find this style

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: A recipe is how the engine draws this style; each version comes from a recipe bundle import and needs Prepress's approval (never whoever imported it).

retired.label: Retired
retired.fix: The base or variant was retired by a master file import

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.fix: Turn off "Hide from the storefront" on the Storefront tab

wave_not_open.label: Wave not open
wave_not_open.fix: Wait for this style's wave to open

no_product_type.label: No product type
no_product_type.fix: Choose the product type it is priced as on the Storefront tab

no_recipe.label: No recipe
no_recipe.fix: Import a recipe bundle that has this style

recipe_not_approved.label: Recipe not approved
recipe_not_approved.fix: Prepress approves the latest recipe (never whoever imported it)

names_not_approved.label: Names not approved
names_not_approved.fix: Marketing and Prepress each approve the Thai / English names

not_makeable.label: No factory makes it
not_makeable.fix: Verify a factory's capability for the processes this style needs

not_drawable.label: Not drawn
not_drawable.fix: The recipe does not draw this combination yet — tell the engine team

priceReasons.option_not_priced: An option has no price rule

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: Every master file and recipe bundle import, and a new one from here
imports.newIntro: Upload the master file (style-library-master.json) or a recipe bundle as JSON. You see a preview first and nothing is written; changes to styles already on the storefront wait for Prepress, then Marketing.
imports.drop: Drop a JSON file here, or choose one

noop.same_checksum: This file was already imported; nothing to do
noop.no_changes: This file changes nothing in the library

imports.pendingHint: These styles are on the storefront: the changes wait for Prepress, then Marketing, in Approvals
imports.confirmBody: Import {file}: {direct} changes at once and {pending} held for approval
imports.heldForApproval: Imported — the storefront changes await approval

coverage.title: Library coverage
coverage.description: Per category, how many variants are shown and can be made; per process, which ones no factory runs yet
coverage.categoriesIntro: Variants shown against all, and why the rest are held back
coverage.processesIntro: A process no verified factory runs keeps the styles that need it on quotation

rules.title: Price & process rules
rules.description: The rules that let a variant price instantly, and that say which machines a style needs

price.title: Option price rules
price.intro: A variant prices instantly only when its type's calculator has a rule for each of its options: "same as the base" or "configures the calculator"

effectHints.neutral: Priced as the style without this option
effectHints.configuration: Sends extra input to the calculator, such as a window or extra die-cutting

price.noteHint: Why the rule exists, at least 3 characters
price.retireBody: Retire the rule for {option} in the {calculator} calculator. Variants with this option go back to quotation.
price.createIntro: One rule is one option value in one calculator
price.patchHint: e.g. '{"window": true}', by the calculator's field names
price.patchInvalid: The configuration must be valid JSON
price.incomplete: Fill in the option, value and note
price.emptyHint: No rule means the option cannot price instantly

process.title: Process rules
process.intro: A style that matches a rule needs that process; a factory verified for it can make the style
process.removeBody: Remove the {process} rule for {scope} {value}; who can make each style is recomputed.
process.createIntro: e.g. styles with a window need window patching
process.incomplete: Choose a process and fill in the value

next.title: Next styles
next.description: Signs of what the library should add or open next, from searches, price calculations, quotation requests and structural design requests
next.totals: {searches} style searches · {suppressed} zero-result searches by fewer than {min} people (not shown)
next.zeroIntro: Only keywords enough people typed, so no searcher can be identified
next.heldIntro: Styles priced through CS or other channels that do not yet pass the storefront's checks
next.rfqIntro: Customers who did not find their style and asked for a blank quotation
next.structuralIntro: Structures customers asked the design team for, and those since added to the library

photo.title: Card photo
photo.intro: What customers see on the style's card, its variant cards and the configurator preview. Without one, the rendered dieline thumbnail is used
photo.none: No photo — the rendered thumbnail is used
photo.renderHint: This is an AI-generated reference. Upload a real photograph to replace it; the storefront then drops its “AI-generated” note
photo.drop: Drop a PNG / JPEG / WebP here, or
photo.wrongType: {name} is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP
photo.remove: Remove the photo, use the rendered thumbnail
photo.failed: The photo could not be saved
